verdict.rationale: Windmill's Git sync commits and pushes each deployed item to a repository and can auto-deploy new commits back into a workspace. CLI deployments from a Git repo, flow version IDs with version-pinned webhooks, and a Compare & Deploy page round out source-controlled versioning and deployment. missing for 10: explicit documentation of dev→staging→prod workspace promotion (multi-environment setup), pre-merge or branch validation workflows, independent hands-on corroboration.
